description: This file implements subtitle processing functions including normalization, quality check, generation, translation, and validation. It primarily provides utilities for handling subtitle files in the SRT format, with placeholders for integration with speech-to-text engines and translation services.

methods.name: str run_quality_check_and_correct( subtitle_path: str, video_path: Optional[str], language: Optional[str], enforce_ott: bool, processed_dir: str, )

methods.name: str generate_subtitles_for_video( video_path: str, language: Optional[str], processed_dir: str, model_hint: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Creates a placeholder generated subtitle file for a given video and language.

methods.name: str translate_subtitles( subtitle_path: str, target_language: str, source_language: Optional[str], processed_dir: str, model_hint: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Simulates translation of subtitles by appending the target language code to each line.

methods.name: List[str] validate_subtitles(subtitle_path: str, options: Dict)
methods.description: Checks subtitle blocks for issues such as line length, lines per caption, and empty blocks, returning a list of issues.
